headline: What a 0.4 mm nozzle
white
can really print
gold
sub: Measured on our own detail test, not guessed.

tips.title: Lines up the wall hold
tips.text: A 0.4 mm groove running up a wall kept its depth at every layer height we tried.

tips.title: Heights snap to layers
tips.text: At 0.2 mm layers, a 0.3 mm groove printed 0.4. Draw heights in 0.2 steps.

tips.title: Too small gets bigger
tips.text: A 0.1 mm groove printed as a whole 0.2 mm layer: twice the size drawn.

tips.title: Small domes are stairs
tips.text: A 1 mm dome is just 5 layers at 0.2 mm. Facet it, or print finer.

tips.title: Letters 3 mm tall
tips.text: Smaller, and letters blob or lose strokes on a 0.4 nozzle.

tips.title: Dots 0.8 mm across
tips.text: On a top face, smaller dots aren't shrunk. They're dropped.
